headline: Microsoft to Offer Buyouts to 60,000 Employees in Cost-Cutting Push
summary: Microsoft will offer voluntary buyouts to 60,000 workers across the United States, Canada, India, and the United Kingdom. Eligible personnel include staff at vice president level and below, according to a company spokesperson.
why: Microsoft is one of the world's most valuable technology companies. Broad headcount reductions indicate management's focus on cost discipline and operating margins amid slowing revenue growth.

impacts.name: Microsoft
impacts.why: Voluntary buyouts lower structural payroll costs and improve operating margins over time.
